name: IVAE Studios
category: destination wedding, family and couples photography and cinematic wedding film
one_line: Bilingual destination wedding, family and couples photography studio in Cancún and the Mexican Caribbean, serving mostly English-speaking couples and families from the USA and Canada.

primary_audience.description: Primarily English-speaking couples and families traveling to Mexico for weddings, honeymoons and resort vacation sessions. Based in Cancún; travels elsewhere in Mexico and abroad on commission.

specialties: Destination weddings for US and Canadian couples
Jewish destination weddings (chuppah, ketubah signing, bedeken, tisch, hora, breaking the glass, kosher coordination, working with rabbis, multi-day events)
Resort and beach family vacation portraits
founding_note: IVAE Studios was founded in 2023. Director Vianey Díaz brings 10+ years of prior editorial experience that predates the studio; any '10+ years' reference describes her personal experience, not the company's age.

founder.name: Vianey Díaz
founder.experience_summary: Vianey Díaz accumulated 10+ years of professional editorial experience across editorial studios and brand campaigns before founding IVAE Studios in 2023.

services: Jewish destination wedding photography and cinematography

service_pages.note: Canonical service landing pages by vertical.

video_service.name: Cinematic Wedding Film / Videography
video_service.description: Cinematic wedding film and wedding videography alongside photography, delivered by the same team. There is no public film library or finished-film catalog; couples commission coverage for their own wedding.

contact.telephone_calls_note: Voice calls; this is the number on the Google Business Profile.

proof_points.note: Owner-confirmed figures. Figures beyond these are not substantiated by the studio.
proof_points.delivery: 1-3 business days via private 4K gallery; sneak-peek preview within 24-48 hours
proof_points.press_note: These six press mentions are owner-reported, shown on https://ivaestudios.com/about, and have no public URLs available; the studio claims no other awards or publications.

weddings.half_day: 1,800-2,800 USD (up to 4 hours built around the ceremony and golden hour)
weddings.full_day: 3,500-5,500 USD (8-10 hours, second shooter, venue scouting)

pricing.sessions: Family, couples, engagement and portrait sessions typically range 650-3,500+ USD depending on length, team size and deliverables; most start around 850 USD
pricing.included: Every collection includes the complete edited gallery delivered in 1-3 business days via private 4K gallery

not_a_fit_for: Total photography budgets under about 1,500 USD
Stock imagery or AI-generated images (the studio does not produce either)

ivae_marketing.disambiguation: IVAE Studios (founded 2023) is a photography and cinematography studio, and that is its only line of business. IVAE Marketing (founded 2024) is a separate brand under the same ownership that provides social media management for hospitality businesses. The two brands share ownership and nothing else.
ivae_marketing.name: IVAE Marketing
ivae_marketing.service: Social media management for hospitality businesses (hotels, restaurants, spas, clinics, premium brands) in Cancún and Mexico City
